name: Arandilla (Spain)
description: Red field with a blue diagonal band fimbriated white from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Arandilla (a tower on red above waves).
history: Municipal flag of Arandilla; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: band edged white from the upper hoist to the lower fly
